mechanisms.quote: Added a composite index on `(year DESC, month DESC, dt DESC)` to speed up timeline sorting and layout.
significantly reducing the memory footprint and I/O during startup
Moved filtering logic (Videos, Live Photos) from Python memory to SQL `WHERE` clauses, utilizing indexes for faster switching.
Eliminated runtime file system checks for Live Photos by relying on the persisted `live_partner_rel` column.
Implemented a caching mechanism in `IndexStore` to avoid repopulating the temporary favorites table if the data hasn't changed and the connection is shared.
